tool: Headless Google Chrome 155.0.8059.82 via DevTools protocol; curl against the local preview
scope: Desktop browser responsive emulation, not physical mobile device evidence

observations.check: iOS and Android labels sit above each hero phone and share its rotation.
Labels render as chips above the phones over the editor.
Over-the-air card shows a version header, three rollout bars and one footer line; the bento visuals no longer draw an inner panel.

Served title 'Mixer | One Swift codebase for iOS and Android'; favicon.ico, favicon-32.png, favicon-16.png and apple-touch-icon links are root-relative; /assets/favicon.ico returns 200 image/x-icon and /assets/favicon-32.png returns 200 image/png.
grep finds no U+2014 em dash under website/ outside node_modules and dist.

finding: The favicon looked missing locally because a manual npm run build rewrote the served output with absolute URLs for the default port 4173 while the preview ran on 4183; icon links are now page-relative.
